exclusion_rationale.scripts/**: PDF/ERD documentation tooling, not shipped product code. Twelve build_pdf generators exceed the 80-line function limit by design as linear document builders; splitting them is churn with no product benefit. See docs/adr/0004-governed-autonomous-engineering.md.
exclusion_rationale.apps/app-web/src/stravyx/components/ui/*: Vendored shadcn primitives kept close to upstream so they can be re-synced. Local restructuring makes that harder.
exclusion_rationale.archive/**: Frozen narrative history from prior agent chats.

architecture_boundaries.name: domain-types-stay-pure
architecture_boundaries.reason: packages/types is the shared domain layer for pricing, visibility projectors and mission authz. It must remain framework- and transport-free so backend, Edge and browser all evaluate the same rules.

architecture_boundaries.name: api-client-is-transport-only
architecture_boundaries.reason: packages/api-client is a stable /api REST surface. Binding it to a UI framework or the Supabase SDK would couple every consumer to one runtime.

architecture_boundaries.name: components-must-use-api-client
architecture_boundaries.reason: Marketplace money and mission logic must go through packages/api-client and the Edge API, never PostgREST from a component. Session wiring belongs in App.tsx. This is the visibility firewall expressed as a dependency rule.

architecture_boundaries.name: edge-api-has-no-browser-client
architecture_boundaries.reason: Edge handlers are the authoritative server boundary. Importing the browser REST client or a UI framework there would invert the trust direction.
